tasks.gr11-software-online-services-mobile-int: Topic: Software, online services and mobile internet. Cover categories of application software (productivity, communication, utility, multimedia), cloud-based services (SaaS, PaaS, IaaS), mobile internet, app stores, responsive web design, website accessibility standards, online collaboration tools, and software licensing (open source, freeware, shareware, commercial). Ask about software-category classification, cloud-service type matching, accessibility-standard questions, and licensing scenarios.
tasks.gr11-fourth-industrial-revolution-inform: Topic: Fourth Industrial Revolution and information management. Cover 4IR and 5IR technologies (AI, machine learning, robotics, IoT, 3D printing, blockchain), impact on employment, PAT phases (planning, collecting, processing, presenting), information management cycle, data quality checks, referencing and plagiarism, and search strategies. Ask about 4IR-technology identification, PAT-phase descriptions, information-quality scenarios, and search-strategy questions.
tasks.gr11-database-reports-spreadsheet-integr: Topic: Database reports and spreadsheet integration. Cover database report design (grouping, sorting, calculated fields, report wizard), importing data between applications, exporting to CSV/Excel, spreadsheet charts and graphs, chart types (bar, line, pie, scatter), data interpretation, pivot concepts, and print settings. Ask about report-design choices, chart-type selection, import/export scenarios, and data-interpretation items.
tasks.gr11-html-mail-merge-design-principles-t: Topic: HTML, mail merge and design principles. Cover HTML links (anchor tags, internal and external), HTML tables (tr, td, th, colspan, rowspan), CSS text and layout properties, mail merge steps (data source, main document, merge fields, output), design principles (alignment, contrast, repetition, proximity), and desktop-publishing basics. Ask about HTML link syntax, mail-merge step sequencing, CSS property effects, and design-principle application.
tasks.gr11-iot-4ir-vr-ar-fake-news-t3: Topic: IoT, the Fourth Industrial Revolution, VR and AR, and Fake News. Cover the Internet of Things with examples and supporting technologies, what the 4IR is, virtual and augmented reality, fake news and how to check information. Ask Grade 11 learners to give an IoT example, tell VR from AR, or say how to check a story.
tasks.gr11-wireless-nfc-gps-mobile-apps-t3: Topic: Hotspots, Bluetooth, NFC, GPS, 4G and 5G, and Mobile Apps. Cover personal and public hotspots, Bluetooth, NFC, GPS and location privacy, 4G and 5G, and installing mobile apps safely with permissions. Ask Grade 11 learners to match a technology to a use or name a risk.
tasks.gr11-gig-economy-phishing-pharming-t3: Topic: The Gig Economy, Phishing and Pharming. Cover the gig economy and decentralised work, phishing and pharming (described only, never instructions), warning signs and safe habits. Ask Grade 11 learners to recognise a gig, a phishing message or a safe habit.
